senses.gloss: डम् डम्, i. 1 or 6. Par. To sound, Prab. 55, 6.
डमरिन् डमरिन् and डमरु डमरु, m. A kind of drum, Bhāg. P. 8, 10, 7; Prab. 55, 6.
† डम्प् डम्प्, v. r. for डप्.

डम्ब् डम्ब्, i. 10, Par. To cast.
 --With the prep. वि वि,
 1. To imitate, Ragh. 4, 17.
 2. To simulate, Hariv. 8406.
 3. To deride, to sneer, Hariv. 1.
 4. To deceive, Bhartṛ. 1, 21. विडम्बित, Low, poor, distressed.

डम्बर डम्बर,
 I. adj.
 1. Renowned, Mālat. 3, 8, Lass. वाच्- [] m. Graceful and eloquent language.
 II. m.
 1. A proper name, MBh. 9, 2541.
 2. A mass, assemblage (as of blossoms), Mālat. 48, last l.. 148, 8; (of clouds), Mahāvīr. 99, 17; Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 37.
डम्भ् डम्भ्, v. r. of डप्.

डामर डामर,
 1. m. An object causing surprise, Gīt. 12, 23.
 2. The name of a people, Rājat. 5, 51.
